description: Issue #147: the issue already names a test file, so the derivation must not double up. `src/session/retry.test.ts` is derivable from `src/session/retry.ts` AND declared by the issue — it appears exactly once in suspected_files and is NOT reported as a planner default, because the planner did not add it. Neither declared test path derives anything of its own: `retry.test.ts` would otherwise produce `retry.test.test.ts`, and `tests/e2e/flow.spec.ts` is excluded by both its directory and its name. Every path the issue wrote is still in scope.
